sar.narrative: Customer C11663, holder of card C11663-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2017-01-31 and 2017-01-31, 1 transaction(s) totalling $1,800.00 were identified as unauthorised on that card, the earliest being transaction 3660153 and the transaction that triggered review being 3660153 for $1,800.00. The activity was conducted through the online channel in billing region 315.0. Card-present purchases were made in a billing region in which the cardholder has no history, while their ordinary activity continued elsewhere, indicating the instrument was cloned rather than travelling. Closed investigation CC-2766 recorded confirmed fraud on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.82 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $1,800.00.

stop_reason: Fraud probability 0.82 clears the 0.70 threshold for the actions this case requires, and out_of_region_use is separated from none by 0.47, above the 0.15 floor.
